name: CHEM 2241
title: Organic Chemistry
description: An abridged course in organic chemistry designed to provide a background for related fields in which a general rather than a detailed knowledge of the compounds of carbon is required.
requirement_description: CHEM 1122 or 1124Q or 1127Q or 1137Q or 1147Q. May not be taken out of sequence after passing CHEM 2443.
